sloka: अवष्टभ्य अवतिष्ठंतम् ददर्श धनुर् ऊर्जितम् ।रामम् रामानुजम् चैव भर्तुः चैव तथा अनुजम् ॥४-१९-२५॥
transliteration: avaṣṭabhya avatiṣṭhaṁtam dadarśa dhanur ūrjitam ।rāmam rāmānujam caiva bhartuḥ caiva tathā anujam ॥4-19-25॥

translations.english: The auspicious lady Tara beheld Rama standing there firmly with his brother and Sugriva, leaning on the best of bows.
